title: Too Much Chips
description: Rory Sullivan, seventh grade, Hudsonville Christian Middle School; Emerson Baker, fifth grade, Black River Elementary.

title: The Problem
description: Chip companies don't have enough chips in their bags, and they don't have enough seasoning on the chips.

title: The Solution
description: Too Much Chips will have extra chips in the bag and extra seasoning on those chips.

title: In the Field
description: We went down to Eighth Street and we pitched to 50 people. 18 expressed interest to buy and 10 bought.

title: Pivot or Scale and Next Steps
description: We're going to try to start to sell in small stores and work our way up.

title: What I Learned About Myself
description: Rory is good at presenting and coming up with ideas, and Emerson is good at designing and coming up with ideas.

title: Thank You
description: Visit https://too-much-chips-landing-page.replit.app/ using the website QR code or alternative link.
